normalization: NFKC and whitespace only; no fuzzy matching
sampling: Coverage-driven 50-case development suite. 13 historical regression + 37 new source-grounded drafts. Not a frequency-weighted production sample.
limitations: 37 new cases need human review; 6 absence candidates excluded from refusal accuracy scoring.
Legacy test files remain unchanged but overlapping topics and prior exposure mean they are historical regression, not a fresh unseen holdout.
Multi-child and cross-section are intended coverage labels until runtime mapping validates evidence geometry.
Known evidence-group coverage is not exhaustive relevant-chunk recall.
Do not tune thresholds against a fresh test split; this suite has only development questions.

response_policy.scope: specified frozen corpus; web search disabled
response_policy.clear_question_missing_evidence: State insufficient evidence in the provided corpus or available material; do not infer absence in the real world or invent details.
response_policy.clarify_only_when: Ambiguity in entity, jurisdiction, policy version or user intent changes the retrieval target.
response_policy.example: The available material does not provide sufficient evidence for me to give a quantified processing-time reduction for this case.
response_policy.implementation_status: Benchmark expectation only; application prompt behavior has not been changed or evaluated in this revision.

previous_review.scope: Only 13 unchanged development cases retain v4 review. New cases are NOT user-approved.

expansion_gate: Add 5–10 policy PDFs only after structure audit, source-anchor integrity, development regression and semantic review pass.
